fluff.overview: Most Clan infantry are solahma warriors at the end of their careers or who have failed their Trials, assigned to duties the warrior caste considers beneath notice. Foot Points are the most basic infantry formation, deployed on foot without transport. Slow and vulnerable in open terrain, they are best suited to garrison duty, facility security, and defensive positions where their lack of mobility is less of a liability. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these Points field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require warriors to carry additional power packs.
